heading_en: Submission of an Application for Approval
summary_ja: 内部格付手法の承認申請書の記載事項、添付書類、内部格付手法実施計画及び先進的内部格付手法移行計画の記載事項を定める。
summary_en: Sets out what the application for approval of the internal ratings-based approach must state and attach, and what the implementation plan and the advanced-approach transition plan must contain.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company seeking the approval under the preceding Article for the use of the internal ratings-based approach shall submit to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency an application for approval stating the following matters. (i) Trade name. (ii) The name and title of the person responsible for ascertaining and managing the consolidated capital adequacy ratio.

The following documents shall be attached to the application for approval in the preceding paragraph. (i) A statement of reasons. (ii) The curriculum vitae of the person responsible provided in item (ii) of the preceding paragraph. (iii) The credit risk management policy. (iv) The internal ratings-based approach implementation plan. (v) The advanced internal ratings-based approach transition plan (limited to where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach newly applies for approval as an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach). (vi) Other documents stating matters that should serve as reference in the examination relating to the approval.

The internal ratings-based approach implementation plan listed in item (iv) of the preceding paragraph shall state the following matters; provided, however, that this does not prevent an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach from not using estimates of LGD and EAD for some business units or asset categories (meaning corporate exposures, sovereign exposures, exposures to financial institutions, etc., residential real estate exposures, qualifying revolving retail exposures and other retail exposures held in the same business unit; the same applies hereinafter in this Chapter) that do not fall under the exposures listed in the items of Article 123, paragraph (2). (i) The scope to which the internal ratings-based approach is applied and the date on which application of the approach begins. (ii) The business units or asset categories planned to be excluded from application of the internal ratings-based approach.

The advanced internal ratings-based approach transition plan listed in item (v) of paragraph (2) shall state matters concerning the scope in which estimates of LGD and EAD will be used, and the time at which their use will begin, for corporate, etc. exposures that do not fall under the exposures listed in the items of Article 123, paragraph (2); provided, however, that this does not prevent estimates of LGD and EAD from not being used for some business units or asset categories.
